free_tier_limits.correction: Trial Edition includes 26,000 API calls and 68,000 messages per month, one data center, up to 50 devices, and up to 10 controllable devices. It is restricted to individual development/debugging, prohibits commercial use, and suspends service when the allowance is exhausted until the next monthly refresh.

rate_limits.correction: Tuya publishes per-project, per-endpoint frequency limits. Examples include 10 requests/second for space creation, 4/second for sending device actions or properties, and 50/second for querying device properties.

notes: The API and documentation are live. The listed base URL is specifically the Western America endpoint; Tuya publishes separate endpoints for six other data-center regions. The entry fails because both the trial limits and endpoint-specific rate limits are officially published, contrary to the supplied values.
